text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: One day, {0} was part-time working as a mailman and visited Alces Atelier for a delivery.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ある日。
{0}が、
郵便配達のバイトで
アルケス錬金堂に手紙を届けに行くと──

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Welcome! ...Or that's what I'd like to say, but sorry, we're closed for the day!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いらっしゃいませ～
……なんですけど、
ごめんなさい。
お店は
今日は臨時休業で……！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Wait, {0}-kun?!
text_block_list.orig_text: って{0}くん！？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Yeah, as you can see, Lou-chan and the others had to go back to their hometown for some urgent business. So, they asked me if I could look after the store while they were away.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
あのね。
ルイちゃんたちが急用で
故郷に帰省することになっちゃって。
それで、
お店の留守を預かってくれないかって頼まれたの。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: She told me while also proposing I could freely practice my alchemy here. I happened to be off work at the time, so I said yes without hesitation!
text_block_list.orig_text:
錬金術の練習も自由にしていいって言ってくれてね。
私もちょうどオフだったし、
二つ返事でオッケーしたって訳！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: So... why do you find yourself here? My, perhaps you came here to visit Lou-chan... That'd make me quite jealous, you know? Hehe, just kidding♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
それで
キミは
何でここに？
もしかして
ルイちゃんに会いに来たとか……
それはちょっと妬いちゃうよ？　
ふふ、
なんてね♪

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Hmm? You're working as a mailman today and are here to deliver a letter? I see... I wonder what I should do in such a situation? Is it okay for me to take it in their stead?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふーん？　
郵便配達のお仕事で手紙を届けに？
そっか……
どうしよう。
私の方で代わりに受け取っちゃってもいいのかな？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Oh! The name on the recipient... is mine! And the sender is... Lou-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ！　
宛先の名前、
私になってる！
送り主は……
ルイちゃんだ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: I see. Maybe she wrote to the shop directly because she knew I'd be here? Hehe, I'm so happy to receive a letter from Lou-chan♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど。
私がここにいること知ってるから、
私宛てにお手紙くれたのかな？
ふふ、
ルイちゃんからのお手紙、
うれしいな♪

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, right, I was in the middle of doing some alchemy. {0}-kun, come on in and join me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っと、
そうだ
錬金術の途中だった。
{0}くんも入りなよ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: "Original Transmutation"!
text_block_list.orig_text: 『基創錬成』！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's finished! Alchemy rank 8! Hi-potion is done~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
完成！
錬金ランク８！　
ハイポーションの出来上がり～♪

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. When I first started, I couldn't even make an alchemy rank 1 potion. Compared to back then, I'm a... little better, you know♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ。
始めたての時は、
錬金ランク１のポーションも作れなかったもんね。
その頃と比べれば多少は、
ね♪

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: I'm still nothing compared to Lou-chan's skill and talent. On the contrary, Lou-chan's skills are getting better and better. She even came up with a new alchemy technique.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルイちゃんに比べたら全然だけどね。
それどころか、
ルイちゃんの技術はどんどん上がっていってて。
ついには新しい錬金の秘術まで編み出しちゃったんだって。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...She dubbed it "Ultimate Synthesis".
text_block_list.orig_text: ……『究極錬成』っていうんだけど。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I wasn't told the details behind it either, but she said it would end up offering a great benefit to people who fight a lot, like me and you, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん。
私も詳しくは教えてもらえなかったんだけど、
私や{0}くんみたいな、
戦う人たちの強い味方になるはずだって言ってた。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Once the preparations for it are complete, I heard all three will start this "Ultimate Synthesis" service, so let's both look forward to it♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
準備が整ったら
『究極錬成』のサービスも始めるらしいから、
楽しみに待ってようね♪

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, I forgot about her letter. I'll read it right now, so wait a second.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っと、
お手紙のこと忘れてた。
ちょっと読むから待っててね。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ふふ♪

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Yeah, something AMAZING! Look, {0}! She wrote: "Follow this recipe and make a luminous sword!"
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
もう最高！　
ほ
らみて{0}くん！
「レシピに従って光を放つ剣を作ってみなさい」
だってさ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: This is definitely a trial for me to see if I can do an "Ultimate Synthesis"! Being tested like this means that people have high expectations of me♪ Hehe, to think Lou-chan has high expectations of me...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これは間違いなく『究極錬成』の試練だよ！
試されてるってことは、
期待されてるってことだよね♪
えへへ、
ルイちゃんが私に期待してくれてる……っ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'll live up to those expectations! I'll use a "Ultimate Synthesis" to create a luminous sword!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし、
期待に応えちゃうよ！
『究極錬成』で光を放つ剣を完成させちゃうんだから！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Really?! You're always so reassuring♪ Well then, I'm counting on you, {0}-kun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんと！？　
すっごく心強い♪
じゃあ{0}くんよろしくね！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Thus, in order to overcome the trial posed to her by Louise Marie, Nozomi decided to try a secret technique called "Ultimate Synthesis".
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうしてルイズマリーからの試練を成功させるため、
ノゾミは『究極錬成』なる秘術に挑戦することになった。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Just as the manual said, we've thrown in the ingredients. Now we just need to mix them with some good salt and plums... and then I'll have to chant the famous magic words...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむ……
手引書の通り
素材は投入したね。
あとはいい塩梅でかき混ぜて……
最後の錬金術の呪文。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: "Original Transmutation"! ...No, those won't do here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
『基創錬成』！
……じゃ、
ないんだよね。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: To successfully perform an "Ultimate Synthesis", a special magic word is needed, not the usual one... and she wrote those instructions right here... Hmm...? What is this...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
『究極錬成』を成功させるためには
いつもの呪文じゃなくって、
特別な呪文が必要……
で、
その呪文が書
いてあるんだけど……
うう……
何これ……？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: "Recite 'Carriage Gas Explosion' three times in a row within three seconds". ...No, wait a second! That's too difficult! Actually, it's absolutely impossible!
text_block_list.orig_text:
「『馬車ガス爆発』を
３秒以内に３回連続で詠唱すること」……
いや
何それ難しすぎだよ～っ！　
絶対に無理～っ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Hm... I guess that makes sense. It is called "Ultimate" for a reason, so it won't be easy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん……
だよね。
なんたって究極なんだもん。
一筋縄じゃいかないよね……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Besides... giving up before even trying isn't like me...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに……
やる前から諦めちゃうなんて、
私らしくないよね……！！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: All right, I'll definitely live up to Lou-chan's expectations! ...Phew, then without further ado...
text_block_list.orig_text:
よしっ、
絶対にルイちゃんの期待に応えて見せるんだから！
……ふう、
じゃあいくよ……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: "Carriage Gas Explosion, Carriage Gas Explosion, Carriage Gas Explo...shun!!" ( TLNote: Those are all tongue twisters, but I left them as is )
text_block_list.orig_text:
馬車ガス爆発
馬車ガス爆発
馬車ガス爆はちゅっ！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Ruaaaack...
text_block_list.orig_text: ボロロ～ン……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Wh-What's with this thing?! How did I end up making a flappy sword?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
何これぇ～！？
ふにゃふにゃの剣ができちゃった！？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I messed up. B-But surely I'll chant it properly and get it done now! ...Car-ria-ge Ga-s Ex-plo-si-on... Okay.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううっ、
失敗だ。
で、
でも
次こそは成功してみせるんだから！
……馬・
車・
ガ・
ス・
ば・
く・
は・
つ……
よし。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Huh? There's more to the letter? ... “For this chant whenever a magic word fails it also loses its effectiveness, so you have to try with another one.” ...Eeeehhh?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
手紙の続き？
……「一度失敗した呪文は効力を失っちゃうから、
また別の呪文でチャレンジしなきゃダメ」
……えぇえっ！？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: A-Another magic word...? Oh, here it is, the second word. "Recite 'Oedo Patent Licensing Office' three times in a row within three seconds"... S-So be it! Bring it on...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
べ、
別の呪文って……
あ、
これだ、
第二の呪文。
「『オーエド特許許可局』を
３秒以内に３回連続で詠唱すること」……
い、
いいわ！　
やってやろうじゃない……っ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. *Breathes in*...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふう。
すう……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: "Oedo Patent Licensing Office Oedo Papp-... Kh!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オーエド特許許可局
オーエド特許許可局
オーエド特許きょきゃきゃっ！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: ZumberaBOOM...
text_block_list.orig_text: ズンべラボ～ン……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: NAAHHHH!? This time, I ended up creating an heavy sword!? Another failure...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああっ！？
今度はどんよりした剣ができちゃった！？
また失敗だ～……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Ugh, and now I can't use the magic word "Oedo Patent Licensing Office"... Next, next up, next up I say!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううっ、
これで『オーエド特許許可局』は使えないのよね……
つ、
次よ次～っ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Two balloon birds in a garden, two b- argh...!?
text_block_list.orig_text: 庭には二羽バルーンバードがいりゅっ！？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Red tunnus, blue tunnus, yellow tutuntu...!?
text_block_list.orig_text: 赤トゥンヌス青トゥンヌス黄トゥントゥンっ！？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Raw Tsumugi, raw Chika, raw Nojomi...!?!?
text_block_list.orig_text: 生ツムギ生チカ生ノジョミっ！？

text_block_list.name: ノゾミ
text_block_list.text:
はあ……
これで99回目の失敗……
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ……
これで99回目の失敗……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: I cannot do it, it's impossible......! This "Ultimate Synthesis" is just......
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダメだ。
できない……っ。
私に『究極錬成』は……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. Thank you, {0}-kun. ...Sorry, I was about to break and give up back there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……えへへ。
ありがとう{0}くん。
……ごめん、
折れそうになってた。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Of course I won't give up! I've overcome every hardship up until now. I can definitely do it... I will definitely succeed!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろん私は諦めたりなんかしないよ！
今までも、
どんな苦難だって乗り越えてきた。
私は必ずできる……
絶対に成功させてみせる！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Because I'm Nozomi from Carmina after all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は
カルミナのノゾミだから！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...This is the 100th magic word written. The very last one. And my last chance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……書かれている呪文はこれが100個目。
これが最後。
これが、
最後のチャンス。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. I'm... doing this...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふう。
すう……
いくよ……！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
The princess next door is a princess who often eats onigiri
The princess next door is a princess who often eats onigiri
The princess next door is a princess who often eats onigiri!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
隣の姫はよくおにぎり食う姫だ
隣の姫はよくおにぎり食う姫だ
隣の姫はよくおにぎり食う姫だっ！！！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I did it!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
やったよ～！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Shaki-Keen!!
text_block_list.orig_text: シャキキーン！！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Wow... The completed sword is glowing like crazy...! We did it, {0}-kun. My "Ultimate Synthesis" was a huge success!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わああ……
完成した剣、
すごい光ってる……！
やったよ{0}くん。
『究極錬成』大成功だよ～っ！！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Hehe, this is the first time I've seen a sword like this...! I wonder how much more powerful it is than a normal sword?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
こんな剣、
初めて見た……！
普通の剣よりもどれだけパワーアップしてるのかな？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Oh, nice idea! ♪ Let's give it a try!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっ、
ナイスアイデア♪
早速試してみよ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Alright, here I come! ...Haah!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし、
じゃあいくよー！
……はあっ！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Zugagagagann!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ズガガガガーンッ！！！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah... it's as if lightning has struck... This sword is incredible... Don't tell me it's a sword that can summon thunder at will! ...Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うん……
まるで雷が落ちたような……
す、
すごいよこの剣……
まさか雷鳴を呼び起こす剣じゃ……
……あれ？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...The firewood, it's not broken at all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……薪、
割れてないね……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Despite the flashy light and sound we just saw, not only isn't the firewood broken, but there's not even a scatch on it...? What's with this sword...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなに派手な光と音なのに、
割れてないどころか
薪に傷一つ付いてない……？
どういうことかな……？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: You're right! Let's see, let's see... Uhhh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんとだ！
なになに……
えーと？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: "So this was all to make a toy Iroha wants, the Shiny Blade of the Kirarin Soldier, Knight of Light." ...
text_block_list.orig_text:
「以上がイロハちゃんが欲しがってるおもちゃ、
光の騎士・キラリンソルジャーの
シャイニーブレードの作り方よ」……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Huh...? A toy? So it's not an "Ultimate Synthesis"...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……
おもちゃ？
『究極錬成』じゃなくって……？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, there seems to be something written on the back too. "Well, I think you probably know this by yourself, but this isn't an 'Ultimate Synthesis' or anything like that. Of course, I'm also lying about the one-time magic words. Those are merely tongue twisters."
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ、
裏にも小さく文字が書いてある。
「ま、
分かってると思うけど
こんなの『究極錬成』でもなんでもないわ。
もちろん特別な呪文とかも嘘。
てか
普通に早口言葉」。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Well, not that I believe you'd ever fall for such a silly and stupid prank, though (laughs). Louise Marie.
text_block_list.orig_text:
「ま、
あなたがこんな、
バカなイタズラに引っかからないとは思うけど
（笑）
ルイズマリー」。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...So it was all a prank?
text_block_list.orig_text: ……引っかかってますけど？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Hm? I'm going to do some alchemy, you know? So before that, I'll have to look it up in the recipe book.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
錬金術を使うんだよ？
その前に調合書で調べないと。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...How to make an effective "laxative potion".
text_block_list.orig_text: ……よく効く『お腹ピーピー薬』の作り方。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: {0} desperately tries to calm Nozomi down as she trembles with an angry smile on her face.
text_block_list.orig_text:
怒りの笑みを浮かべプルプル震えるノゾミを、
必死でなだめる{0}だった。
